title: Evolved: Mission 24
notes: Vault reads your saved games (savegame in the game folder) and never touches the game.
Save once in each new mission: the missions before it count as beaten. The last mission can only count as reached.
Not yet tested on a real save. If nothing pops after saving, send a test report from the game page.

testGuide.title: Save in mission 2
testGuide.detail: Beat the first mission, then save early in the second. The first mission's achievement should pop.
